problem_spec:
def problem_spec
-- function signature
(impl: String → String)
-- inputs
(text: String) :=
-- spec
let spec (result: String) :=
  (result = "" → text = "") ∧
  (result ≠ "" → (
    (∃ pref s, text = pref ++ s
      ∧ pref.length = 1
      ∧ pref ≠ " "
      ∧ result = pref ++ impl s)
    ∨
    (∃ pref s : String, text = pref ++ s ∧ pref ≠ "" ∧ (∀ ch, ch ∈ pref.toList → ch = ' ')
      ∧ let k := pref.length;
        (k ≤ 2 → result = (String.replicate k '_') ++ (impl (text.drop k).toString))
      ∧ (2 < k → result = "-" ++ (impl (text.drop k).toString))) )
  )
-- program termination
∃ result, impl text = result ∧
-- return value satisfies spec
spec result
test_cases:
#test implementation "Example" = "Example"
#test implementation "Example 1" = "Example_1"
#test implementation " Example 2" = "_Example_2"
